description: Reopen r-sort-3-corpus-accdb (ACCDB) read-only. Reads stored values (ID, K) of T and U in ID order, then the ID sequence of SQL SELECT ID FROM T ORDER BY K, ORDER BY K DESC, ORDER BY K, ID; the same ORDER BY K on the incrementally built T2, on U (ascending and descending) and on both copies of the compression table C. Asks the public SQL order and tie order of each indexed Text column, kept apart from DAO index traversal.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
